name: io.github.NBibikov/cogvault
title: cogvault
description: Local hybrid-search memory for AI agents over plain Markdown. Multi-tenant, offline, no LLM.

packageArguments.name: --tenant
packageArguments.description: Directory of Markdown memory cards for this agent (one directory = one isolated tenant)

environmentVariables.name: COGVAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model override; otherwise .cogvault.toml in the tenant, then the multilingual default

environmentVariables.name: COGVAULT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Recall log: 'off' to disable, or a path to relocate the JSONL log
